Car Engine Loop 96kHz, 4s
Author: qubodup / Iwan Gabovitch
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/car-engine-loop-96khz-4s
Licensed here under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC BY 3.0).
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

Original recording: engine-loop-1.wav, 96 kHz, 24-bit stereo.
Brick Racers adaptation: DC removal, high-pass/low-pass filtering, 40 ms
loop crossfade, gain normalization, conversion to 48 kHz/24-bit PCM WAV.
Playback adds variable pitch, throttle-controlled filtering, gain envelopes,
and stereo positioning for rival engines. No endorsement is implied.

Preparation script: scripts/prepare-engine.py
Original download: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/engine-loop.7z
